probes.note: data.oregon.gov is a Socrata portal. If PAPA notices are published here the whole source collapses to a config like configs/wa_sepa.json with no new code, so this is probed first.
The public reporting tool for proposed and adopted PAPAs. Expected to be ASP.NET WebForms; a viewstate finding here is the evidence that the 'small adapter' in the source scan is the wrong shape.
The notices page. Probed for a download link, feed, or report route rather than for the notices themselves.
Proposed amendments page, the pre-decision half of the register and the half that matters for opposition timing.

discovery.note: Oregon requires every city and county to file a Post-Acknowledgement Plan Amendment notice with DLCD for any comprehensive plan amendment or zone change, and DLCD must publish proposals and adoptions weekly — precisely the instrument an Oregon data center rezoning uses, captured statewide before the vote. The 2026-09-02 scan called this 'not Socrata, so a small adapter'; that was an assumption, and the first probe here tests it directly. Registered 2026-09-09.
